subject: Burst package options and proportional discount request
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@greenline.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcy Li <marcy.li@greenline.com>, procurement@greenline.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on burst/overrun pricing for launch week

Hey Rishi —

We're two weeks out from our public beta and traffic projections just jumped. Ops is asking for a concrete plan for short-term headroom and how overage will be billed should we exceed our committed quota. Specifically: can you provide a one-week burst package (minutes-to-hours granularity), the per-token overrun rate during that window, and any conditional discounts if we convert the temporary uplift into a quarterly commit?

We want to avoid a surprise invoice and would prefer a clear, capped path (even if it costs more than pay-as-you-go). Also, procurement will need a line item and a short description we can insert into the PO.

Thanks —
Oliver
VP Product, Greenline Labs

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@greenline.com>
Cc: ben.carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, lauren.bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on burst/overrun pricing for launch week

Oliver —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the beta ramp. Short answer: yes, we can do a time-bound burst bundle with a capped overrun rate and a conversion discount if you elect to roll the uplift into a committed tier within 60 days. I've attached a short pricing sketch and a proposed PO-friendly description (Greenline_Burst_PRICING_v2.pdf). Key points below: 

- 72-hour burst block (can be split into multiple windows) priced at a blended uplift of 1.8x your standard token rate, applied to usage within the burst window. This gives predictable ceiling pricing.
- Overrun during the burst window: fixed per-token surcharge (0.45 USD per 1k tokens) above committed quota for that window; surcharge capped at a maximum NTD (Net Token Dollars) per day — see attachment for examples.
- Conversion path: if you convert the uplift to a quarterly commitment (3 months) within 60 days of the burst, we will credit back 50% of the uplift delta applied during the burst period, applied as retroactive credits against the first invoice in the commit.
- If procurement needs a single-line PO: "Temporary burst capacity (72h) — capped overrun protection; includes conversion credit if rolled into 3-month commit."

Ben and Lauren — can you confirm the legal/finance guardrails for the conversion credit mechanics? We should also confirm how flexible we are on the 1.8x blended uplift (request from Greenline: prefer a stronger discount if they sign quarterly).

I'll wait for your input and will follow up to Oliver with a final one-page terms blurb and a DocuSign link for a short addendum.

—Rishi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, lauren.bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on burst/overrun pricing for launch week

Adding a few operational notes and recommended concession band:

Rishi / Lauren —

Operationally we can reserve a 72-hour burst pool tied to Greenline's existing dedicated quota; provisioning is straightforward. A couple of guardrails: 
- Burst windows must be scheduled at least 2 hours before we spin GPU pools (we can do emergency 30-min provisioning for a 10% expedite fee).
- We track and bill burst usage at the request-level; transparent reporting will be available in the console.

Pricing play: given this is a beta with clear expansion potential, I suggest offering 1.6x blended uplift and a 60% retro-credit on the uplift delta if they sign a 3-month commit. That gives them a stronger incentive while protecting our margin. If legal flags the credit magnitude, reduce to 50% but include a cap (equal to the cost of the burst pool).

Also attaching the redlined contract snippet for procurement language (contract_snippet_redlined.pdf). For PO text keep it concise, procurement prefers a single line and the doc reference.

If you want to be conservative on exposure, we can include a daily cap clause: "Redwood liability for burst-related credits capped at $X/day." Recommend we propose a cap equal to two days' burst cost.

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@greenline.com>
Cc: Marcy Li <marcy.li@greenline.com>, ben.carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, lauren.bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick question on burst/overrun pricing for launch week

Oliver —

Appreciate the urgency. Based on internal ops and finance alignment, here is the proposed, deployable path: 

1) Temporary burst offering (what we'll provision): 72-hour burst pool (can be split into up to 3 windows) — provisioning lead: 2 hours (standard) / 30 minutes (expedite +10% fee).

2) Pricing summary (applies only to usage within the burst windows):
   - Blended uplift: 1.6x your current standard token rate (applies to tokens consumed during burst).
   - Overrun surcharge: $0.40 per 1k tokens above committed quota, with a daily surcharge cap equal to 2x the daily burst pool price.
   - Retro-credit on conversion: if Greenline converts the uplift into a 3-month committed volume within 60 days, Redwood will apply a 60% credit of the uplift delta for the burst window to Greenline's first invoice under the commit (credit capped at total cost of the burst pool).

3) PO language (single-line for procurement): "72-hour temporary burst capacity with capped overrun protection and conditional conversion credit (see Greenwood Addendum #DL-3491-GREEN)."

4) Next steps: I'm attaching the pricing sketch and a redlined snippet for your PO/procurement team. If this looks good, we'll generate a short addendum (DocuSign) that you can sign; provisioning will start once the addendum is executed and we've received the nominal PO.

Would you like us to reserve a soft hold on the burst pool for Friday of next week? We can hold for 48 hours with no charge.

Thanks —
Rishi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
